svg.title: The MechCrate AI loop
svg.desc: A coding agent calls the mx MCP server, whose rag_context tool embeds the query and searches a pgvector store hosted on Neon or a local Postgres. The store is filled by mx rag ingest from the sixty-seven markdown docs under docs/development. Those docs are written and revised by a weekly research pipeline that opens a pull request; a human reviews and merges it, and only merged docs are ingested. The same docs are published to this site.
